page.overview:
Who is Ucy?

"Brutal Bull" Ucy is a that regularly competed as a gladiator in Dressrosa's Corrida Colosseum, where he was befriended (and named) by Monkey D. Luffy.

He serves as an ally to Luffy during the Dressrosa Arc.

Ucy is a large bull with dark fur, long horns (the left eventually broken by Hajrudin) and a bulky body. He also has small eyes, bearing three eyelashes on each.

He is described by Gatz as the "Colosseum's Grim Reaper", and his fighting style has led him to become known as the "Brutal Bull". Despite this, Luffy was still able to tame and befriend him using his Supreme King Haki.
